en: An old sepia-toned postcard with an ornate decorative frame around a central photograph of a calm waterfront with boats, houses and wooded hills in the background. At the top is a heraldic shield with three green fir trees. The word "Gustafsberg" appears near the top left in red script. Below the image there is stamped purple text indicating that the item belongs to a museum, along with a date in 1903.
